intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: Khazinti ("خزينتي") is a personal finance application designed with privacy as a core principle. This policy explains what data is collected, how it is stored, and your rights as a user.

data_collection.title: Data We Collect
data_collection.content: Khazinti collects only the minimum data necessary to operate. All financial data you enter is stored exclusively on your device and never transmitted to our servers.
items: Financial data you enter (accounts, transactions, budgets, subscriptions) — stored locally on your device only
App preferences (language, theme, number format, notification settings) — stored locally on your device
PIN hash and biometric credentials — stored in your device's secure storage (expo-secure-store), never transmitted
Anonymous advertising identifiers — used by Google AdMob to serve ads (can be reset in your device settings)
GDPR consent status — stored locally to respect your advertising preferences

data_storage.title: How We Store Your Data
data_storage.content: Your financial data is stored entirely on your device using the following mechanisms:
items: SQLite database (expo-sqlite) — all financial records (accounts, transactions, budgets, subscriptions, categories)
AsyncStorage — simple app flags (e.g., whether you have seen the welcome screen)
SecureStore (expo-secure-store) — sensitive credentials such as your PIN hash and user identifier
No cloud sync, no remote database, no third-party storage of your financial data

third_party.title: Third-Party Services
third_party.content: Khazinti uses a small number of third-party services for specific functions:
items: Google AdMob — displays interstitial ads to free users; Premium users see no ads. AdMob may collect advertising identifiers per Google's privacy policy.
Google UMP (User Messaging Platform) — manages GDPR consent for advertising in the EU/EEA
Frankfurter API — provides live currency exchange rates (no personal data sent, only a currency code request)
Open Exchange Rates API — fallback currency rate provider (no personal data sent)

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.content: Khazinti can send local notifications for the following purposes (all optional, configurable in Settings):
items: Budget alerts — when your spending reaches 50%, 75%, 90%, or 100% of a budget limit
Subscription payment reminders — before a subscription renewal date
Large transaction alerts — when a transaction exceeds a threshold you set
Low balance alerts — when an account balance falls below a threshold you set
Daily spending summary — a daily recap of your income and expenses

user_rights.title: Your Rights
user_rights.content: Since all your data is stored locally on your device, you have full control:
items: Access: all your data is visible directly in the app
Delete: use the Factory Reset option in Settings to permanently erase all app data
Export: use the Backup & Restore feature to export your data
Advertising: reset your advertising ID in your device settings, or opt out via the GDPR consent form
Notifications: disable any or all notification types in the app's Notification Settings

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.content: Khazinti is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be reflected in the app's changelog and on this page with an updated date.
